nodes.summary: Write $(a; q)_\infty = \prod_{n \ge 0} (1 - a q^n)$ for the infinite $q$-Pochhammer symbol and $j(x; q) = (x; q)_\infty \, (q/x; q)_\infty \, (q; q)_\infty$ for the product-form Jacobi theta function. For all complex numbers $x$ and $q$ with $0 < |q| < 1$, $j(q/x; q) = j(x; q)$. This includes $x = 0$, where $q/0$ is read as $0$.
nodes.title: Symmetry of the Jacobi theta product under $x \mapsto q/x$

nodes.summary: Write $(a; q)_\infty = \prod_{n \ge 0} (1 - a q^n)$ for the infinite $q$-Pochhammer symbol and $j(x; q) = (x; q)_\infty \, (q/x; q)_\infty \, (q; q)_\infty$ for the product-form Jacobi theta function. For every complex number $q$ with $|q| < 1$, $j(0; q) = (q; q)_\infty$. Here $q/0$ is read as $0$, so the first two factors of $j(0; q)$ both equal $(0; q)_\infty = 1$.
nodes.title: Jacobi theta product with vanishing first argument

nodes.summary: Write $(a; q)_\infty = \prod_{n \ge 0} (1 - a q^n)$ for the infinite $q$-Pochhammer symbol and $j(x; q) = (x; q)_\infty \, (q/x; q)_\infty \, (q; q)_\infty$ for the product-form Jacobi theta function, where $|q| < 1$. For every complex number $x$, $j(x; 0) = (x; 0)_\infty$: since $0/x = 0$ (also for $x = 0$, reading $0/0$ as $0$), the last two factors of $j(x; 0)$ both equal $(0; 0)_\infty = 1$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
